QuestInfo.name: Phantom, the Thief Hero
QuestInfo.2:
#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/408/0#
You were assigned to talk to Phantom, so you met with Empress Cygnus, who suggested writing a really big sign to flag down Phantom's airship.

You were perfecting your sign when Phantom finally showed up.

Phantom wanted to know your true motivation for battling the Black Mage. He stole your skills, to see if you had what it took.

After pulling his little prank, Phantom revealed that the Seal Stones wouldn't help you. You had to save Maple Island with your own abilities. With that discouraging news, you head back.

When the others reconvened, you put together this knowledge:

#eMaple Island had no Seal Stone.#n
